s1.title: Service, Not Self
s1.intro: Supporting The American Legion and honoring those who have served, by strengthening the lives of veterans, military members and their families, at home and abroad.

s2.heading: For God and Country
s2.text:
We advocate for veterans, educate our community, mentor young people, and promote patriotism, good citizenship, peace and security. Through service, fellowship and compassion, we try to make a real difference for the people who have given so much for our freedom.

As one of the nation's largest patriotic service organizations, the American Legion Auxiliary has shown for more than a century what volunteers can do. Here in Cambria, Unit 432 does it one dinner, one Bingo card and one helping hand at a time.

s2.caption: Unit 432 on parade

box_1.heading: Thursday night dinners
box_1.text: A home-cooked meal with a new menu every week, $12. Tickets go on sale at 5 PM. First come, first served.

box_2.photo_alt: The Auxiliary's flag-covered car advertising monthly Bingo.
box_2.heading: Bingo night
box_2.text: Doors open at 5 PM and games start at 6 PM. Everyone is welcome.

box_3.photo_alt: A jar of donations surrounded by red memorial poppies.
box_3.heading: Poppy program
box_3.text: Our oldest tradition: red poppies in remembrance of those who served, with donations supporting veterans and their families.

questions.question: Veterans Affairs & Rehabilitation
questions.answer: Assistance, advocacy and volunteer service for veterans and their families, from visiting hospitalized veterans to connecting families with resources, so those who served are never forgotten.

questions.question: Children & Youth
questions.answer: Programs that support the physical, emotional, educational and spiritual needs of young people, and help create safe, supportive places for children to thrive.

questions.question: Girls State & Girls Nation
questions.answer: Premier leadership and civics programs where young women experience government in action. Since 1937, Girls State has introduced generations of young women to responsible citizenship.

questions.question: Education
questions.answer: Supporting quality education and encouraging students to pursue their goals beyond high school, working with local schools and educators.

questions.question: Community Service
questions.answer: Volunteer projects and partnerships that respond to local needs and make our community stronger, more caring and more connected.

questions.question: Auxiliary Emergency Fund
questions.answer: “Women helping women”: temporary financial help for eligible Auxiliary members facing an emergency.

questions.question: Legislative & National Security
questions.answer: Helping members stay informed about issues affecting veterans, military families and our nation's security, and speak up to their elected representatives.

box_1.heading: Become a member
box_1.text: Membership is open to family members of veterans eligible for The American Legion. Not sure if you qualify? Just ask.
